messages.Em caso de incidente de segurança que po:

(a) Notification to the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) within 72 (seventy-two) hours after confirmation of the incident, in accordance with Art. 48 of the LGPD.

(b) Communication to affected data subjects, within a reasonable timeframe, containing: description of the nature of the affected data, information about the risks, measures taken to mitigate the effects and guidance for the data subject.

(c) Internal incident record with complete documentation: nature, affected data, impacted data subjects, technical measures taken and results of containment actions.

(d) Notification to the User (when Catalisa acts as Processor) so that they may take the necessary measures with their customers.

messages.Para explorar uma ideia, o site armazena:
To explore an idea, the site stores your answers and creates a provisional identity after you give your name. Before AI generation or support, it requests a valid email address or phone number; either one is sufficient. An essential cookie lets you resume only the same session. Provisional site references are not CRM records.

The agent receives the brief, context needed for generation or refinement, and the authorized capability catalog. Your name, email and phone are not intentionally included in the generation request. However, do not include sensitive customer information, credentials or secrets in free text. The AI generates a product hypothesis; it does not approve credit, execute transactions or publish a system.

When you confirm continuation, you share your contact information, answers, history, selected concept and refinements with the team. The human channel currently implemented is here on the site. Acceptance means the packet was stored; delivery means an authenticated person opened the context; assignment means that person claimed the request. Replies remain in the same conversation. Collecting an email or phone does not automatically send external messages.

Contact, Lab, concepts and support surfaces do not send conversations, names, emails or phone numbers to browser analytics tools. Proposed market measurement requires specific approval and public information before real collection. To request access, correction or deletion, use the privacy contact identified in this policy; identity and request scope will be checked before changing data.

messages.Ao conectar sua conta Google à Catalisa:
When you connect your Google account to Catalisa or Facila, Catalisa, the data controller, accesses only the data needed for the features you enable. For questions or requests about this data, contact privacidade@catalisa.io.

The use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy (https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy), including the Limited Use requirements.
messages.Login com Google (openid, email, profile: Google sign-in (openid, email, profile): we access your name, email address and profile photo to authenticate you and identify your account.
messages.Gmail (gmail.send): enviamos e-mails som: Gmail (gmail.send): we send emails only from your own account. In Facila, each send requires the customer’s explicit approval; in Catalisa, sends are triggered by workflows you create. We do not read, store or modify the contents of your mailbox.
messages.Google Calendar (calendar.events, calend: Google Calendar (calendar.events, calendar.calendars.readonly, calendar.calendarlist.readonly, calendar.freebusy): we read your calendar list, calendar names, time zones and free/busy information. We create, update and cancel appointment events on the calendar you choose.
messages.Finalidade e compartilhamento: usamos es: Purpose and sharing: we use this data only to provide the features described above. We do not sell it, use it for advertising or use it to train AI models. We do not transfer it to third parties except as needed to operate the service or as required by law.
messages.Uso proibido: é proibido usar a integraç: Prohibited use: using the integration for spam, fraud or unsolicited messages is forbidden and leads to suspension of the integration or account.
messages.Segurança e armazenamento: os tokens OAu: Security and storage: OAuth tokens are stored encrypted, with access restricted to authorized people and systems that need them to operate the service.
messages.Retenção e exclusão: os dados obtidos do: Retention and deletion: data obtained from Google and OAuth tokens are deleted when you disconnect the integration or request deletion by emailing privacidade@catalisa.io.
messages.Revogação de acesso: você pode revogar o: Revoking access: you can revoke access at any time inside the app or at https://myaccount.google.com/permissions.
messages.Acesso humano: pessoas não leem esses da: Human access: people do not read this data except with your explicit consent, for security purposes (such as investigating abuse or incidents), to comply with a legal obligation, or when the data is aggregated and anonymized.
